media.caption:
60 Years. One Legacy. A Thousand Journeys. ❤️

For six decades, WHS Gupkar Road, Srinagar has been more than a place of learning. It has been a place where curiosity is encouraged, character is shaped, talent is nurtured, and dreams take flight.

From the classroom to the playing field, from the laboratory to the chessboard, WHS has always believed that true education is about developing minds that think, hearts that care, and individuals who lead.

Today, we celebrate six decades of learning, values, friendships, achievements and memories — carried forward by generations of WHS Students & Alumni across the world.

60 years of shaping minds.
60 years of building character.
60 years of inspiring futures.

The legacy continues.

This is WHS. ❤️

Happy 60th Anniversary, WHS Gupkar Road! 🎉

media.caption:
60 Years of Memories. 60 Years of Inspiration. 💙💛

As we celebrate 60 glorious years of WHS Gupkar Road, Srinagar, we are delighted to share the journey of one of our proud alumni, Dr. Raies Khan, Batch of 1994.

From the classrooms of WHS to a career spanning over two decades in healthcare, Dr. Raies Khan’s journey has taken him across India and into international and overseas healthcare initiatives, with organisations including GVK EMRI, Shalby Hospitals, ASG Hospitals, and Paras Health, among others.

Reflecting on his journey, Dr. Raies shares how WHS gave him more than an education—it gave him a strong foundation of values, friendships, confidence, and memories that have remained with him throughout the years.

From Kashmir to different parts of India and beyond, every chapter of his professional journey has been shaped by the experiences and values he carries with him from his school years.

Proud to be a WHS Students & Alumni, Dr. Raies remains grateful to the school that helped shape the person and professional he is today.

As we celebrate six remarkable decades of learning, friendships, growth, and cherished memories, stories like his remind us of the lasting impact of WHS Gupkar Road and the remarkable journeys of its alumni.

Here’s to 60 years of WHS, 60 years of memories, and 60 years of inspiring generations.

Happy 60th Anniversary, WHS Gupkar Road, Srinagar! 💙💛

#60YearsOfWHS #WHSHouseSchool #WHSSrinagar #WHS60 #60YearsOfInspiringMinds

🌟 Celebrating Our Distinguished Alumni – Mr. Rohit Khattar

One of the earliest students of WHS Gupkar Road, Mr. Rohit Khattar has gone on to become a pioneering entrepreneur and a leading name in Indian hospitality.

As the Founder-Chairman of Old World Hospitality and the visionary behind acclaimed brands including Indian Accent and Chor Bizarre, his journey from the early days of WHS House to the heights of the hospitality industry is truly remarkable.

His achievements continue to be a source of immense pride for the entire WHS House community.

As we celebrate 60 years of WHS Gupkar Road, we honour the alumni who have carried the spirit of our school into the world. 💙

60 Years of Memories. 60 Years of Inspiring Generations. 💙

As we celebrate 60 remarkable years of WHS Gupkar Road, Srinagar, we are reminded that a school’s true legacy lives on through the generations it shapes, the dreams it nurtures, the friendships it creates, and the memories that stay with us forever.

In this special anniversary message, alumnus Adnan Shah, Batch of 2005, looks back with pride and gratitude at his journey as a part of the WHS family.

From classrooms to lifelong connections, WHS has continued to inspire young minds and create a legacy that extends far beyond school years.

Here’s to 60 glorious years of learning, growth, friendship, and memories, and to many more years of inspiring generations to come.
